title: Horizon Radar V2 Observation Identity Policy 1.0
authority: Authoritative for Observation identity, source URL canonicalization, Observation deduplication, and Observation time semantics.
observationSemantics: An Observation is a Radar evidence relationship between one Event and one canonical Source. It is not a fetch execution, crawler run, or daily report occurrence.

identity.observationId: first 16 lowercase hexadecimal characters of digest

urlCanonicalization.trailingSlash: remove trailing slash from non-root path; root path remains /

timeSemantics.observedAt: Required; time Radar first records an Observation or timestamp on the current Observation record. Explicit ISO 8601 date-time.
timeSemantics.sourcePublishedAt: Optional; original publication time from Source.
timeSemantics.retrievedAt: Local state only; fetch/read execution time.
timeSemantics.eventOccurredAt: Event field, not part of Observation identity.
timeSemantics.refetch: Same eventKey, canonicalSourceUrl, and radar with changed observedAt/retrievedAt retains observationId. Registry may update lastObservedAt, retrievedAt, and metadata without adding an identity.

deduplicationRules: Same Event + same canonical source URL + same Radar = same Observation identity.
Different canonical source URL for same Event = different Observation.
Same Event and source URL under different Radars = two Observations; Event remains the same.
Metadata changes do not change observationId.

supersession.supersedes: Event Policy 1.0 observationId definition only: radar:entity:eventKey:source:date
supersession.eventPolicy: Event Policy 1.0 remains authoritative for Event semantics: eventKey, canonicalEventType, fingerprint, NEW, DUPLICATE, UPDATE, and materialChange.
